subject: general
question:
The following chart shows the production of an organization in various years from 2012 to 2016. Study the chart and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/754c3fb8a0f704dda963f50851b42720253e45d432f5725e71707e74e34722d7.png] 

What was the percentage increase in the production from 2015 to 2016?
solution:
**Given:**

Production in 2015 = 12.6 tonns

Production in 2016 = 18.9 tonns

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Increase = dfrac{{Current Production} - {Previous Production}}{{Previous Production}} times 100</span
